title: Rocky Fortune
paragraphs: NBC sustaining crime/adventure series starring Frank Sinatra as odd-job worker Rocky Fortune.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: 25-program NBC run (October 6, 1953 to March 30, 1954) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Frank Sinatra (performer), Andrew C. Love (director), George Lefferts (writer), Barney Phillips (performer), Maurice Hart (performer), Edward King (announcer), and Frank Gerstle (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] and [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]].

The stories often return to odd jobs and temporary employment, crime, murder and criminal schemes, theft, robbery and fraud, sports, fights and fixing, Hollywood, theater and entertainment work, and ships, waterfront and maritime work.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes NBC sustaining crime series, Frank Sinatra as Rocky Fortune, Odd-job crime-adventure premise, and AFRTS preservation forms.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|nbc-university-theater|NBC University Theater]], [[show|escape|Escape]], and [[show|broadway-is-my-beat|Broadway Is My Beat]].
